title: Live Quiz Show
tagline: Every phone in the room becomes a buzzer.
shortDescription: A host-led trivia battle on the big screen while the whole audience answers live from their phones. Points reward speed and accuracy, a leaderboard climbs between rounds, and a podium crowns the winner.
longDescription: If you've ever played Kahoot or run a Mentimeter poll, you already know the format: a question lands on the main screen, everyone grabs their phone, and a countdown turns a quiet room into a roaring contest. This is that energy, built for live events and fully on brand. Players join in seconds by scanning a QR code, with no app and no login, and a single host drives the whole room from one screen. Each round shows the question and answer tiles big, players tap before the timer runs out, and points are awarded for getting it right and getting it fast. Between questions a live leaderboard reshuffles, streaks build tension, and a final podium names the champion. Question packs can be trivia, product knowledge, opinion polls, or a branded mix; everything is skinnable to the client's look, runs in multiple languages, and scales from a small workshop to a packed conference hall. It's the fastest way to pull a passive audience into the action and keep every person leaning in until the last question.

highlights.title: A Format Everyone Already Knows
highlights.description: Clients picture it instantly: "like Kahoot, but ours and on brand." No demo needed to get a yes, and no learning curve for players on the day.

highlights.title: Zero Install, Whole-Room in Seconds
highlights.description: Players scan a QR code and play straight in the browser, with no app and no sign-up. The room fills up fast, which makes it an easy sell for big audiences.

highlights.title: One Host Runs Hundreds
highlights.description: A single operator drives the entire game from one screen. Light on staff, light on hardware, high on perceived value, and a strong margin for the reseller.

highlights.title: Modes, Buzzers & AI Question Packs
highlights.description: Switch up the mechanics: solo vs. team mode, sudden-death finals, double-points wagers, fastest-finger buzzer rounds, and image/audio/video questions. AI can draft a full question pack from a brief or a PDF, and sponsor-locked rounds open up paid add-ons.

highlights.title: Skin It To Any Brand or Topic
highlights.description: Same engine, any world: a product-launch trivia night, an onboarding or compliance quiz, a festival pop-culture showdown, a sustainability challenge, or a Christmas edition, with colours, copy and questions all reskinned to fit.

highlights.title: Every Tap Is a Data Point
highlights.description: Add a data layer to capture participation, response rates, accuracy per question, completion, and opt-ins. With it in place, the client walks away with proof of engagement, a read on what the audience knows or believes, and an export for their post-event report.

highlights.title: Plays Well With Others
highlights.description: Pair it with Prize Draw to reward the champion, with Journey Manager to make it one stop on a longer route, or with Live Feed to push live results onto secondary screens around the venue.
